findings.evidence: openspec/changes/claude-external-advance/specs/model-routing/spec.md:1 declares only ADDED Requirements, and line 5 requires receipt-backed detection-only advances to be classified as verified. openspec/specs/model-routing/spec.md:639–650 still permits verified advances only with native hard containment and mandates that all detection-only movement remain a violation. The delta does not modify or remove that existing requirement, leaving contradictory mandatory behavior.
findings.summary: The added requirement contradicts an existing requirement that explicitly forbids accepting detection-only head movement.

findings.evidence: template/scripts/finish_task.py:522 records advanced_from whenever branch differs from main_branch, even when both branches already point to the same commit. After the no-op merge and successful publication, lines 528–537 unconditionally call record_integration_advance. template/scripts/delegation_containment.py:373–374 rejects identical before/after heads. Thus retrying after a pending Project reconciliation (finish_task.py:1147–1156), or finishing a branch with no new commits, raises before completion reconciliation can proceed despite no integration advance occurring.
findings.summary: Direct finish fails after successful publication when retrying an already-integrated task branch.
